title: fe parachute
script:
local parachute = Instance.new("Tool",game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack)
parachute.Name = "Parachute"
parachute.TextureId = "rbxassetid://12092573037"
parachute.CanBeDropped = false
parachute.RequiresHandle = false
local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity",parachute)
velocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,-10,0)
parachute.Equipped:Connect(function()
velocity:Clone().Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
end)
parachute.Unequipped:Connect(function()
game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart:FindFirstChild("BodyVelocity"):Destroy()
end)
